scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @surplus/shared && concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm --workspace @surplus/frontend run dev" "npm --workspace @surplus/backend run dev"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build --workspace @surplus/shared && npm --workspace @surplus/frontend run dev
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace @surplus/shared && npm --workspace @surplus/backend run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @surplus/shared && npm run build --workspace @surplus/backend && npm run build --workspace @surplus/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @surplus/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @surplus/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @surplus/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @surplus/frontend
